decision_rule: Record all four attempts, native settings and PNG bytes/hash; incomplete, invalid, interrupted or non-reviewed results remain UNKNOWN. Attributed human review required; no cross-device speed inference.
limits: Qwen and ERNIE use different generators and devices; equal seed is not equal noise. Both use eight steps for this control; Qwen production defaults to forty. ERNIE is an earlier diagnostic capture, not a prospective paired warrant. Enhancer and product filtering are unknown. The current Qwen server forwards true_cfg_scale and negative_prompt to its pipeline only when cfg_scale > 1.0; these requests use 1.0, so the submitted negative prompt is not effective on Qwen. Requested parameter equality is not effective conditioning equality; ERNIE effective behavior must be recorded independently.
